semantics.routine_identity: regprocedure plus namespace/name/prokind/arg types+modes+names/defaults/result; preserve all overloads including procedures, never name-only selection
semantics.dependencies: pg_depend transitive forward edges plus relation-attached triggers/constraints/rules/defaults/policies; both FK endpoints and TOAST/index/type identities; cannot see all PLpgSQL string-body/dynamic calls
semantics.acl: raw grantor/grantee/is_grantable plus effective privileges for runtime principals and owners; membership ADMIN/INHERIT/SET and grantor retained; effective privilege is not grantability
semantics.namespace: all selected schema relation kinds, generated objects and routine kinds, relation-scoped constraint/trigger identity; no inferred equal definitions
semantics.writers: all app function/procedure definitions, triggers including internal/deferred and incoming FK triggers, rewrite rules and DML privileges; externally issued SQL/dynamic calls require separately reviewed writer census
semantics.lineage: existing safe receipts/ledger source identities needed; no application row query, invented ledger contents or applied marker
semantics.managed: Auth helper descriptor/ACL only, body withheld; other managed definitions/ACL require separately reviewed protected reference; never mutate

required_external_reviews: OID-to-portable-qualified-identity mapping and hash normalization review
transitive source edges for SQL/PLpgSQL/dynamic/generated dependencies beyond pg_depend
trigger/writer scope including external callers and pending C03
lineage records and exact source equivalence

mapper_bridge.requires: All complete mapper sections plus reviewed external evidence; raw export cannot become reference oracle

not_authorized: No catalog extraction execution or historical query replay by Core; coordinator must review any narrow missing-field request.
